figures.finding: The same Act covers screenwriters and directors as workers in the industry: the regional minimum wage, hours and rest rules apply to them, and no guild agreement sets a fee above it (see blockers).

blockers.sought: What a play's writer is paid in Philippines (the playwright's minimum: a commission fee, an advance, a royalty).

tried.web-search: 2026-11-04: 1 search (8 of 10, standard): 'Philippines theater director playwright fee stage actor talent fee per performance rate guild' (Results: Inquirer 'At last, a theater actors guild' (TAG PH), Inquirer 'The stolen stage' and the Phantom item (a P5,000 per foreign performer per show fee, not local pay), a Senate bill (Singers Equity, HB 281, 15th Congress), Philstage/Gawad Buhay. No published rate for a stage director, playwright or actor.)
tried.institution: 2026-11-04: Cultural Center of the Philippines (culturalcenter.gov.ph), the state theatre: 'Virgin Labfest 2026 opens its stage for new entries' and 'VLF calls for submission', read whole for any honorarium, royalty or director's fee (The call sets the entry rules (one-act plays about 25-35 pages, unpublished, not staged commercially for more than two performances, five languages) and names no payment to the playwright or director.)
tried.official-register: 2026-11-04: Lawphil copy of Republic Act 11996 (Eddie Garcia Act, 2024), read for its coverage of stage directors and writers (Section 3: 'This Act applies to all workers engaged in the movie and television industry' only; stage work is outside it, and the Act sets no fee rate in any case. No statute or order on a stage director's or playwright's minimum found.)
